comments.text: Skip while a background for this scene is still being generated. Skipped messages do not count toward the frequency.
With a frequency above 1, only every Nth story message is checked. The count is kept in the world state agent's scene state as scene_background_check_cnt.
Generation needs Generate New Backgrounds and a Visualizer image backend.
The decision model keeps or picks an existing background when it is sure; otherwise the selection request runs.
